independent_review_note: No independent scientific assessment is claimed.
limitations: Global damaged-hypercube infinity norm is not claimed exactly for dimensions five and higher; only the specified row norm and a sharp lower bound are established. Unequal weights, multiple deleted edges, and non-Euclidean data are outside scope. Earlier unindexed equivalent computations remain an originality risk.
scientific_integrity: An exact heat-kernel and rank-one update proof covers the claimed rational row sums at all dimensions; exhaustive exact-rational spectral and grounded-Laplacian cross-checks certify full norms only in dimensions two through four. The single-edge-failure threshold is not extrapolated from finite tests.
title: A single deleted hypercube edge increases sharp gradient-reconstruction sensitivity from dimension four
